description.value:
You conjure a vision of a creature's deepest terror. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop what it's holding and become frightened for the duration. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

A frightened creature must use the Dash action and flee from you by the safest route available on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to go. If it ends a turn unable to see you, it may attempt a Wisdom saving throw, ending the power on itself on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 3
